Subject: Follow-up: Data handling & training-on-customer-data opt-out

Hi Alice 

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Redwood will not use any customer-provided content from API requests to improve or retrain models unless you explicitly opt in.
- We provide configurable logging controls (redaction, sampling) and retention windows per account.
- Data residency: hosted inference can be pinned to our US or EU regions; Dedicated/Private options support on-prem/VPC for stricter residency.

You mentioned that AcmeFin needs explicit written confirmation that no customer request data will be used for model improvement (training-on-customer-data opt-out) and would like the Data Processing Addendum (DPA) signed.

Can you confirm the following so we can generate the paperwork?
1) Confirm: Opt-out of training-on-customer-data (yes/no)
2) Preferred data residency (US/EU/Other)
3) Any additional logging/retention constraints (e.g., delete logs after N days, never log PII)

I'll loop in Rishi and Neha from our security/compliance team for any follow-ups.

Thanks,

Hi Laura 

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirmations below: 

1) Opt-out of training-on-customer-data: YES  AcmeFin requires written confirmation that request data will not be used to improve models.
2) Data residency: US (we process customer PII under US jurisdiction).
3) Logging/retention: We need logs to be retained for 90 days for troubleshooting, but PII must be redacted at ingest and never logged in cleartext. If redaction is not possible for a subset of flows, we need a documented process and encryption-at-rest with limited key access.

Please send the DPA and any internal security summary for our legal team.

Best,

Hi Alice / Laura 

Thanks for the context. Quick notes from security: 

- Redaction & PII handling: We support configurable redaction rules at the organization level (regex or field-based). For any flows where redaction isn't feasible we recommend client-side redaction or tokenization before sending.
- Retention: We can set logs to a 90-day retention window for AcmeFin. After 90 days logs are purged automatically. We can also configure shorter windows for specific routes if needed.
- Encryption & key access: Data at rest is encrypted via customer-managed keys (KMS) for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted customers we offer KMS integration with strict access controls; we keep a limited ops/key-access roster and provide key rotation.

I'll flag an internal ticket to document the encryption/access list for the DPA appendix. Laura  I'll attach the security appendix draft to the DocuSign envelope before sending.

-Rishi
